Mayo Clinic Primary Biliary Cirrhosis Baseline and Status Data for Randomized Patients

Source: R/data.R
pbcseq_baseline.Rd

Adapted from survival::pbcseq, this dataset contains baseline and outcome status data among randomized patients in the Mayo Clinic primary biliary cirrhosis trial. Accompanies pbcseq_visits which contains follow-up visit data preceding status.

Usage

pbcseq_baseline

Format

A data frame with 312 observations of six variables:

id

case number

age

in years

sex

m/f

trt

1/2 for D-penicillmain, placebo

futime

Time at status

status

status at endpoint, 0/1/2 for censored, transplant, dead

Source

Adapted from survival::pbcseq.

T Therneau and P Grambsch, "Modeling Survival Data: Extending the Cox Model", Springer-Verlag, New York, 2000. ISBN: 0-387-98784-3.
